concept.title: Health checks and assessments
concept.shortdesc: Having health checks, screenings and assessments of a person's needs, abilities or skills.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Having routine health checks, tests and screenings such as blood pressure, eye tests, baby development checks and other diagnostics.
: Having or carrying out an assessment of a person's needs, abilities or skills, such as an initial, clinical, falls, skills or driving assessment.
